_comment: Probe configuration (SPEC-001 CA-1/CA-2). Model ids, runs, prices and weights are configuration, not code (FOUNDATION No-negociables). Values follow the sdd-probe dictamen recorded in docs/epicas/EPIC-001-ciclo-0-baseline-y-validacion-del-problema/SPEC-001-ajustes-del-probe-para-el-baseline.ledger.md.
